correctness.rationale: Exact cubic-ring graph construction gives 24 distinct vertices and 60 edges; exhaustive face enumeration gives 5,301 nonempty simplices, matching 2,628 disjoint pairs, a complete 5,301-vertex/22,728-incidence acyclicity certificate and one 0-, nine 3-, 35 4-dimensional critical cells. Signed algebraic Morse elimination gives a 9-by-35 integer boundary with an explicit 9-by-9 determinant -1 minor at the stated columns. The three-skeleton is a wedge of 3-spheres, whose π3 is freely generated by the cells, so unimodular attachment cancellation leaves 26 four-spheres. A separately implemented high-precision graph and mod-2 chain computation independently verifies the face counts and Betti vector. Both code files were run successfully; finite-field ranks are not substituted for integral attaching degrees.

value.rationale: The snub cube is a canonical 24-vertex quintic chiral Archimedean solid. Its independence complex is a natural graph-topological invariant whose 5,301 nonempty faces span dimensions 0–7 yet whose entire integral homotopy type concentrates in degree 4. The nontrivial nine-by-nine integral unit minor and complete cellular reduction establish structure inaccessible from the graph face vector or field-valued homology. This is a motivated exact classification of a natural object, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a claimed general polyhedral theorem.
